title: TS-1/spherical activated carbon composites in the epoxidation of methyl oleate
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7111-7120
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08189G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Adrián Osorio Hernández, Michael Goepel, David Poppitz, Muslim Dvoyashkin, Roger Gläser
Different diffusion regimes observed in methyl oleate epoxidation are correlated with catalytic activity. The complex composite catalyst can be understood as TS-1 crystallites as “active sites” on a spherical activated carbon (SAC) support.
